notes: The copula stays with pesach: la-YHWH is attributive to it rather than the clause's predicate, so rule 49's closing paragraph hands the copula to the nominal while the preposition fuses into the English genitive Jehovah's.
arba'ah asar is fused to fourteenth under rule 30, and the supplied the of the fourteenth day joins the noun, no article morpheme standing on yom.
